lateral-raise.criteria: Standing bilateral lateral raise; slight elbow bend, lift near shoulder level and controlled return; no torso momentum.

front-raise.criteria: Standing bilateral front raise; pronated grip, slight elbow bend, arms rise toward horizontal without leaning back.

cable-rope-hammer-curl.criteria: Low pulley rope curl with neutral grip and stationary upper arms; controlled elbow flexion and return. Rope branches retain length and stack follows cable travel.

limits: Procedural illustration with simplified equipment, hands and clothing, not human motion capture or biomechanical certification. One-second pause is illustrative. No full mesh collision guarantee. Local playback reviewed; production and physical Android device pending.
